info.title: Movete Fácil — QORE Mobile STAGING API
info.description: Contrato de interfaz STAGING. NO LIVE, NO producción, NO pagos reales. La identidad siempre proviene del bearer verificado.

get.summary: Private JWT-bound AUTO and delivery offer discovery
get.description: Driver-only server-filtered offers, independent of push delivery. No caller-supplied actor identity or private passenger information. STAGING QA only.

200.description: Verified Driver private offers for AUTO and delivery

get.summary: JWT-bound courier polling fallback, independent of push receipt
get.description: Only active offers for the verified courier. Caller cannot supply actor identity. STAGING only.

expiresAtMs.description: Server-validated offer expiry in epoch milliseconds

get.summary: JWT-bound Driver-only private KYC status (no document bytes)

200.description: Latest sanitized status per KYC type

post.summary: Register observed, independently verified Storage metadata; fail-closed until scanner is installed

202.description: Pending record, not approved or eligible

post.summary: Exclusive JWT Admin review of pending Driver evidence

200.description: Immutable audit receipt, never LIVE eligibility

post.summary: One-time JWT-bound conversion to exclusive Driver role, never LIVE
post.description: User must have single default passenger role, explicit consent, no passenger trip/delivery history; driver remains pending compliance. Service-role RPC only in isolated STAGING.

get.summary: Read the latest reviewed license status for the authenticated Driver
get.description: STAGING QA only. A reviewed license is necessary but NOT sufficient for vehicle eligibility. No identity, path, hash, GPS or document bytes are returned.

200.description: Document-only KYC readiness for this JWT-bound Driver

Success.description: Respuesta autenticada STAGING; los flags live permanecen false.
